# Daily OS

> Daily OS is a local-first daily planning and review agent for macOS. It builds a time-blocked daily plan from Feishu (Lark) calendar and tasks, GitHub issues, Linear work and local notes, sends it to Feishu, reviews the day in the evening, and carries unfinished work to the next day. The service runs on the user's own Mac; it has no cloud account or server of its own. Free and open source.

## Product

- [Home (中文)](https://alexli-77.github.io/daily-os/): overview, how it works, privacy model, FAQ
- [Home (English)](https://alexli-77.github.io/daily-os/en/): the same page in English

## Source code

- [daily-os-backend](https://github.com/alexli-77/daily-os-backend): the service (scheduler, data sources, Feishu interaction, local console), Node.js, AGPL-3.0
- [daily-os-macos](https://github.com/alexli-77/daily-os-macos): native macOS client and shared design system, Swift, MIT

## Facts

- Platform: macOS only; an iOS client is in development
- Requirements: Node.js 22+, Codex CLI login or an OpenAI API key, lark-cli login or a Feishu custom app
- Status: alpha, installed from source; latest service release v0.2.0
- Author: Yang (Léon) Li, https://github.com/alexli-77
